name: Create integration store (free and paid plans)
description: Create integration store (free and paid plans) Creates an integration store with automatic billing plan handling. POST /v1/storage/stores/integration/direct
context:
POST /v1/storage/stores/integration/direct
Creates an integration store with automatic billing plan handling. For free resources, omit `billingPlanId` to auto-discover free plans. For paid resources, provide a `billingPlanId` from the billing plans endpoint.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)
